capabilities: auto-format tables after a typing pause in Live Preview or Source mode
format all files in the vault with one command
configure cell padding and delimiter row dash count
preserve column alignment colons in the delimiter row
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README also includes developer release/versioning instructions.
problem: Obsidian does not re-align Markdown table columns, so tables become uneven and hard to read as cells are edited.
summary: Table formatter that re-pads and aligns Markdown tables on save or after a pause in typing.
